entries.analysis: Successful Watchlist lay with strong mechanism support. Fourth, beaten 19 lengths after a slight error at the fifth and no extra before the last. Principal Soul Asylum made all and won easily by 12 lengths; rank 3 Young Rebel third, rank 2 Jessbers Wish pulled up. Demonstrated hurdle evidence supplied the anticipated route against high-class bumper potential at equal weights. Moonverrin, another bumper-transfer runner, finished second, so this is not evidence that bumper ability cannot transfer. Keep the successful case in its original Watchlist group.

entries.analysis: Successful Watchlist lay; second-ranked Silver Hill won by a neck from third-ranked Champagne Chic. Principal Rickety Bridge fourth. Torrent lost position after the fourteenth and was quickly beaten, pulled up after three out. This supports the existence of capable opposition, but does not isolate the 9 lb rise as the cause of failure. Silver Hill had limited actual chase evidence and Champagne Chic was a chase debutant, so avoid retrospectively calling both proven chase threats. Red Dirt Road was NR; the first direct result retrieval at 14:28:12 GMT showed that withdrawal, with exact withdrawal time unknown and no reconstructed pre-off warning.

entries.analysis: Successful Watchlist lay with a clear demonstrated-opposition route: principal Echoing Silence won by 5 lengths. Place De La Nation was third, beaten 5.5 lengths, having disputed after four out before a slight mistake at the next, then no impression on the winner. Rank 2 Bambino Fever fifth; rank 3 Sainte Lucie fell at the last when a moderate fourth. Carrigmoornaspruce, covered outside the principal list, was second. The favourite's Grade 1 hurdle class transferred to a competitive chase effort; the result does not prove a general failure of high-class hurdling ability to transfer.

entries.analysis: Failed lay and a decision-weighting concern. Won by 5 lengths despite being not fluent two out and making a mistake at the last. Handlethekettle, original rank 2, was second; rank 3 Treasure Planet fourth, 26 lengths behind; principal Washington last of five, 29.5 lengths behind. Washington's 5 lb rise did help reverse his previous order with Handlethekettle, but that comparison did not establish either would beat Mwabani. The recognised Chepstow win, opening mark of 115, course experience and scope for handicap improvement deserved more consequential weight. Good opposition was real, but the favourite's own progress proved stronger. Do not turn this into a blanket exclusion of progressive novice winners.

entries.analysis: Successful Watchlist lay, with mixed rival-ranking support. Fifth, beaten 8.95 lengths on Sporting Life cumulative margins, after tracking the leaders and finding no extra following a slight mistake two out. Third-ranked El Champo led until caught close home and was second, a head behind winner Al Kalila, outside the principal three but covered in the original whole-field appendix. Rank 2 Watch The Weather third; principal Rockonliam seventh. Broad opposition worked; the principal rival did not. Karl's latest win had been a NOVICE chase and the rise only 2 lb; this does not establish that the rise stopped him. Preserve this v1 boundary rather than rewriting its scope after success.

entries.analysis: Successful lay; weaker support for the original rival ranking. Sixth, beaten 4.85 lengths on Sporting Life cumulative margins, after making headway but no impression inside the final furlong. Original principal One For Harvey fifth; La Belle Forest seventh; third-ranked Diamond Dreamer third. Winner Nuevo Slovo was reviewed in the whole-field appendix but was outside the principal three, and runner-up Little Jaybee was also outside them. This supports broad competition more than the claim that One For Harvey supplied the decisive route. A mark/course revival remained plausible before the race; defeat alone does not disprove it.

entries.analysis: Successful Watchlist lay, narrowly, with a named third-ranked winner. Ocastle Des Mottes made all and beat Zanoosh by 1.25 lengths; she challenged two out and kept on. Principal Lovely Hurling third; rank 2 Frankie John fourth. This supports Ocastle's actual chase-win route, but the favourite's recognised Grade 1 hurdle ability and mares allowance transferred into a strong chase debut. Do not call her transfer a failure or treat this narrow defeat as proof she could not win. No promotion from this small experiment.

entries.analysis: Successful lay with some mechanism support, but incomplete winner ranking. Sixth, beaten 8 lengths; tracked the leader, lost second over a furlong out and weakened inside the final furlong. That is consistent with the anticipated late vulnerability at this course/trip, but one run does not establish permanent non-stamina. Winner Notable Charm was explicitly identified as a substantial whole-field staying alternative, outside the original principal three. Rank 2 Calshot Spit second, rank 3 Chilli King fourth, principal Noble Grace fifth. The broader staying-opposition case worked; the first-ranked rival did not.
